spiritual_reading.full_translation:
For the third completion, when denial rose again into conscious activity, it set the lowest obscurity in motion and drew it into a single operative mass; and those who were immersed in the most external and buried falsities were stirred within the first established state of their opposition.

After a long interval, because there was no peace from any reception of living good and truth, what lay shut up within that denial forced itself outward from its inward recesses. A sufficient series of primal corruptions issued from the first intention of spiritual death: obscured understanding, self‑inflaming love, unstable persuasion, falsified truth, and active negation of good. These surged forth again with renewed insistence, and they were fixed into determinate habits and settled modes of life, until spiritual death stood established within them as their ruling principle.

From this there followed a further completion: works wholly evil, brought forth through a sufficient set of organized distorted perceptions, each operating within its own general domain of falsity.

Then denial extended itself into all derivative lives throughout those general domains—lives fashioned and propagated from those evil works. This became the full array of merely bodily life and the total system of falsities in which spiritual death was made to dwell. And it divided into a complete duality, sufficient in the active form and sufficient in the receptive form, so that corruption might operate through both.

And as the lowest falsity, by its ruling affection and dominant persuasion, sustains those primal corruptions, so also this complete duality fed the burning of self‑love and the craving of merely bodily delight. By binding the active and receptive together and yoking them into one force, they were set fast in opposition to the first good that directly confronts evil. In this is the terminal state of such denial: it was judged and held outside heavenly order without end.

Along with this there came forth, within that denial, a hidden fullness of falsities organized as a complete set, all established against the first good that confronts evil. This fullness manifested as an entire series of ruling errors—total persuasions of falsity—arising from a complete framework of outward knowledges perverted into governing influences that mislead.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: The chapter reads as a sequential unfolding of denial into fixed corruptions, then into perverted perceptions and works, then into derivative lives and a dual operation, climaxing in permanent opposition to the first good. The main stumble is the inconsistent internal numbering (“third time,” then “second time,” “fourth part”), which suggests stitching from multiple strands; spiritually the progression remains coherent as repeated surges followed by consolidation.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate, but the sentence-end tag “the first part” is a stitching marker that no longer matches its immediate context. It reads like a list-item label pasted onto a narrative clause.
findings.evidence: Text: “...they that are in the [depths] of the earth of darkness [the] first part.” The spiritual reading notes: “The phrase about ‘the first part’ is abrupt in the source.” This is classic seam-language: the paragraph otherwise narrates a functional process (thought ‘came forth’, ‘moved’, ‘gathered’), then suddenly drops a catalog label (“first part”) without syntactic integration.
findings.scope: Remove the dangling catalog tag: “ [the] first part.”

findings.diagnosis: Expansion/stitching at a seam: two competing enumeration systems (“third time” from ¶2, then “the second time” here) have been conflated, producing internal numbering incoherence. The functional narrative is intact, but the embedded time-count is an intrusive systematizing label from another strand.
findings.evidence: Text: “Yet, after a long time... the five elements of death... which are smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness...; the second time [and it came to pass] they were sculpted...” The spiritual reading flags: “ ‘Second time’ and ‘fourth part’ language is inconsistent with the opening ‘third time’; ... suggests stitching from multiple strands.” If you read ¶2 → ¶3 without “the second time,” the flow improves: eruption → listing of elements → embodiment. The element-list (by function as emanations of ‘death’) fits correspondential teaching; the time-label does not.
findings.scope: Excise only the intrusive enumeration phrase: “; the second time [and it came to pass]”

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential sequence with intact fivefold cosmology: ‘trees’ → ‘fruits’ → ‘creatures/worlds’ → differentiation into male/female. The teaching proceeds by generative function (fruits produce creatures; creatures populate worlds), not by jurisdiction or named administrators.
findings.evidence: Text: “The fourth part is the evil fruits... in the five trees... in the five worlds...” and “The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures... formed and generated from the five fruits of death... It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female...” The spiritual reading could render this as functional derivation without forcing alien agents; its only earlier complaint concerned numbering mismatch, not conceptual fit here.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential climax: nourishment/yoking imagery explains mechanism (how elements are sustained and intensified) and culminates in condemnation. No administrative inventory; “First Man” functions as the opposed pole in the process narrative.
findings.evidence: Text: “...its spirit and its thought, they nourished the five elements... also... the ten parts... nourished them, as they yoke them with one another... established against the First Man... condemned for ever.” The spiritual reading explicitly translates ‘First Man’ functionally (“first good confronting evil”) and finds the progression coherent. This is exactly the substrate style: causality via feeding/yoking/establishing.

findings.diagnosis: Overlay intrusion into a functional chapter: astrological-administrative schema (“twelve signs of the zodiac,” “twelve powers”) is introduced as an external classificatory framework rather than arising from the preceding functional process (elements → fruits → bodies → yoking). It reads like a systematizing addendum bolted onto the condemnation climax.
findings.evidence: Text: “The twelve spirits of error... from the twelve signs of the zodiac and from the twelve powers that are in them.” The spiritual reading notes a “SHIFTS” marker and admits “exact mechanism is opaque,” supplying an interpretive bridge (“outward knowledges perverted”). That opacity is diagnostic: the spiritual sense does not arise from what ‘zodiac signs’ *do* in this chapter’s causal chain; instead it imports a governance/cosmological taxonomy (twelve signs/powers) typical of administrative overlays.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶7 as an administrative astrological overlay (twelve spirits of error derived from zodiac signs/powers) appended to the correspondential condemnation sequence in ¶2–¶6.

textual_criticism.summary: 5 findings. Two seam/stitch problems in the substrate narrative (¶2 dangling ‘first part’; ¶3 intrusive ‘second time’) recommended for excision. Core correspondential teaching in ¶4–¶6 is coherent (no action). ¶7 is best explained as an administrative astrological overlay appended to the chapter’s functional arc; recommend annotation rather than carving it up.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: ⟨p.48⟩ [The third time, when the thought came forth from the land of darkness,] it moved it and [it moved it and gathered it together;] they that are in the [depths] of the earth of darkness.

Yet, after a long time, as there was not [any rest or quietness], it gushed and streamed up [from its inner parts,] the five elements of death that gushed [from the first root of death,] which are smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness [up from it;] they were sculpted [that] those in which death was established [into bodies and forms of their own;].
The fourth part is the evil fruits [that came about] in the five trees that are in the five worlds of the land of darkness.

The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures that exist in the five worlds; the ones that were formed and generated from the five fruits of death. They are the five worlds of flesh, the five creations of darkness in which death has been established. It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female [female parts.].

Now, like the land of darkness, in that its spirit and its [thought,] they nourished the five elements [that are in them]; this is also [how] the ten parts that are in male and female, the fire and lust of the flesh [nourished] them, as they yoke them with one another [nourish] they were established against the First Man. This is [the end] of the darkness, it was condemned for ever.

Alongside the mystery of these twelve parts that came about in the darkness [that were established] against the First Man. The twelve [parts are] the twelve spirits of error that came about from the twelve signs of the zodiac [and from the twelve powers that are in them.].

changes_summary: Applied Finding 1 (¶2): excised the dangling catalog tag “ [the] first part.” Applied Finding 2 (¶3): excised the intrusive enumeration phrase “; the second time [and it came to pass]” to restore numbering coherence. No other changes: Findings 3–4 recommended none, and Finding 5 recommended annotation only (no textual modification).
